Subject: Clinical NLU assessment — proposed PoC runbook & next steps

Hi Marta — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed runbook so we can get alignment before scheduling a kickoff. Please review and confirm or suggest edits.

High-level pain & goals (your words):
- Triage accuracy for inbound clinical messages is inconsistent across specialties (avg F1 ~0.68).
- Need to automate intent extraction and routing to reduce manual triage load (target: 40% fewer manual touches).
- Latency requirements: single-utterance inference < 250ms p50 in production.
- Must comply with SOC2 and support on-prem/private deployment option for PHI-sensitive flows.

Proposed PoC scope (6 weeks):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + environment setup — deliver: access checklist, test dataset (de-identified), API sandbox credentials.
2) Week 1–2: Prompt set + initial evals — deliver: 3 prompt families (triage, routing, summary) + baseline metrics (precision/recall/F1).
3) Week 3–4: Iterative tuning & safety checks — deliver: prompt/eval improvements, hallucination regression test, failure cases doc.
4) Week 5: Integration test & latency tuning — deliver: perf profile (p50/p95), KV cache config suggestions.
5) Week 6: Handoff & success review — deliver: scorecard vs success criteria and a recommended runbook for production rollout.

Owners:
- ClearBay: Marta (Product lead), Ethan (CTO)
- Redwood: Grace (AE, program lead), Ben (Solutions Eng, technical lead), Karthik (Platform SE, infra/access)

Success metrics (to validate at PoC close):
- Intent extraction F1 >= 0.82 on the agreed prompt set.
- Reduction in manual triage volume >= 35% on pilot traffic.
- p50 inference latency <= 250ms (sandbox conditions); reproducible on Dedicated/Private testing.

Access & security needs (what we'll need from ClearBay to start):
- De-identified sample dataset (S3 link or secure upload) + data schema.
- Network: temporary VPC peering or SFTP credentials for dataset exchange.
- Account admin to accept Redwood's NDAs/standard PoC T&Cs (link in related links).

Attachments: Cleaned first draft PoC runbook (ClearBay_PoC_Runbook_v1.pdf) and access-checklist.csv (owners & credentials map).

Next steps (please reply with confirmations):
- Confirm scope and owners above (yes/no + edits).
- Share preferred kickoff window: options we have are Thu 9/9 10:00–11:00 PT or Tue 9/14 09:00–10:00 PT.
- Attach the de-identified sample or let us know if you need a secure upload link.

Thanks — I can turn any updates into a mutual action plan after your reply.

— Grace

Adding a quick technical runbook note for kickoff:

- Ingest: we'll provide a temporary S3 prefix and a presigned upload flow. For initial evals, a de-id CSV (columns: msg_id, text, source, timestamp) is sufficient. Please include an example mapping row.
- Sandbox creds: we will create a sandbox API key tied to the PoC deal; limits: 500 req/min, 5k tokens/day. If ClearBay needs higher throughput for perf tuning, we can switch the sandbox to a dedicated node for the tuning window.
- Latency tests: to validate p50 <= 250ms you should run tests from a region that resembles production. If you want, we can spin a Temporary Dedicated node in us-west-2 for the perf window (cost memo required).
- Observability: we'll push a shared dashboard (token-level latency + per-prompt pass/fail) and enable a prompt-set regression alert.

I'll prepare the network checklist and the temp dedicated cost note before the kickoff.

-ben
